title: ADR revisions, week of 2026-11-25: rolling checklist of ADR text out of step with main (one governed PR)
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed · Source: maintainer. Ruling-ref: the rolling weekly card the maintainer accepted on 2026-11-20 (「adr接受你的建议」, recorded on #36086). Opened by triage, because a new single ADR revision card (#37238) arrived and no card of this name is open (`execution-duties.md`: no open card ⇒ open next week's; `triage-duties.md`: a new single ADR revision card moves in at first touch and is closed as folded). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：本周所有「ADR 写的和现在代码不一致」或「ADR 留给某张卡回答、卡已做完」的修订，都收在这一张卡里，最后合成一个 PR，你只批一次。
- 收录规则：只收与主干矛盾、或已被落地 PR 回答的条目；纯补记不收。
- 要你做什么：PR 准备好以后批一次（`docs/adr/**` 需要你亲手批）。

## How this card works
- Each ADR passage that disagrees with `main`, or each open item a landed PR answers, gets one checklist row. A seat that finds a new one appends a row here instead of filing a card. A row names the ADR, the section, what the ADR says, what is true now, and the landing PR.
- Each row lands as an append-only dated note. The original decision text is not rewritten.
- A row whose prerequisite PR has not merged stays unchecked. The PR carries only rows whose code is on `main`.
- The card closes when its PR merges. The next week's rows open a new card of this name.

## Rows
- [ ] **ADR-0146, the amendment's "32 registered types"** (from #37238, seat repo:objectstack#4 zone a4-S, N1 of the contract review on PR #37219, 7152914447). The amendment says "32 registered types". What is true now: `ai_context` was registered (#37173), so `main` has 33, and ADR-0084's tier table (merged in #37219) lists 33 rows. The dated note gives the count, or better, points to ADR-0084's table so the number cannot drift again. Prerequisite: PR #37219 merged (met).
